annotation.title_en: Road Traffic Act Enforcement Regulations (Cabinet Office Order)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cabinet Office (formerly Prime Minister's Office), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Road Traffic Act Enforcement Regulations (1960, as amended; latest amendment effective 2026-09-01). It sets vehicle classes, licensing and driving tests, and includes chapter 2-7 on permits for 'specific automated operation' (Level 4 driverless vehicles), plus standards for remotely operated small vehicles (delivery robots).
key_provisions_or_claims: Chapter 2-7 sets police commission permits for specific automated operation (Level 4), with application contents and plans.
Requires a specific automated operation chief, remote monitoring device (video, audio, location, cybersecurity), and on-site response personnel with training.
Vehicles must display an 'automated operation in progress' indicator.
Remotely operated small vehicles (sidewalk delivery robots) must meet size, 6 km/h speed, emergency stop button standards, and be notified a week before operation with third-party safety examination.
Sets driver licensing, test, and renewal procedures for conventional vehicles.
